title: Monochromatic Portrait with Text Overlay
coreRelationships: The subject's profile creates a strong diagonal line, guiding the eye across the composition.
The monochromatic color scheme unifies the subject and background, creating a cohesive, moody atmosphere.
The text acts as a focal point, contrasting with the textured background and the subject's form.
The soft, out-of-focus background provides depth and separates the subject without distracting.
reuseFormula: Generate a monochromatic, sepia-toned portrait of a person in profile, looking left or right, with a grainy texture. Overlay a single word or short phrase in all caps, using a light, regular-weight sans-serif font, centered horizontally and positioned in the middle third vertically, allowing for slight overlap with the subject. Maintain a low saturation, high contrast palette.
